text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - model-catalog-config-mismatch fired for `llama-serve-prod` (alert id: PD-89234). Symptoms: tokenizer-error-rate spike, 5xx responses from runtime, and sudden increase in decode failures. See alert details: https://pagerduty.example/PD-89234

alice_oncall: acked on PagerDuty. I'll take triage. Marking incident channel and pinging runtime/sre. Any immediate customer impact?

bob_runtime: looking now. seeing lots of `tokenize()` exceptions in runtime logs - sample: ```2024-06-12T15:12:04Z ERROR runtime.tokenize: TokenizerMismatchError: expected vocab size 50257 got 50000 for model rev=7.3.0``` So runtime loaded model binary for rev 7.2.1 but catalog metadata points at 7.3.0. Requests for 7.3.0 route to 7.2.1 artifact.

carol_sre: thanks. that will cause garbled tokens and 5xx. Check catalog history - only change last promotion window. Anyone who promoted rev 7.3.0 today?

bob_runtime: yeah we pulled a promotion job earlier. looks like promotion job updated catalog metadata without pushing matching tokenizer artifact to object storage. The artifact for tokenizer-v7.3.0 is missing -> fallback to older artifact -> mismatch.

dave_custsuc: we got an alert from a customer (AcmeAnalytics) reporting lots of broken completions in their pipelines ~15m ago. They are seeing high error rates and partial outputs. Telling them we're investigating.

alice_oncall: immediate mitigation options: a) rollback catalog default for `llama-serve-prod` to previous revision 7.2.1 b) switch traffic to fallback model-variant `llama-serve-stable` c) temporarily disable model routing for affected customers. My plan: attempt a catalog rollback (fast) unless objections.

erin_product: rollback is fine. prioritize minimal customer disruption. Need a post-incident note for customers and whether to escalate to SOC for compliance.

carol_sre: rollback command (catalog control plane): ```sh
# set default revision back to 7.2.1
redwoodctl catalog set-default --model llama-serve-prod --revision 7.2.1 --reason "automated-promo caused tokenizer mismatch"
```

bob_runtime: I'm tailing runtime logs and watching tokenization errors, will be ready to revert if anything breaks.

alice_oncall: running rollback now. ```
$ redwoodctl catalog set-default --model llama-serve-prod --revision 7.2.1 --reason "hotfix: tokenizer mismatch"
Applied catalog.default for llama-serve-prod -> revision 7.2.1
Propagation started to runtime router groups: us-east-1, eu-west-1
```

incident-bot: Rollback job triggered (job id: RB-5401). Notifying deployment watchers. :white_check_mark:

bob_runtime: seeing immediate decrease in TokenizerMismatchError counts. sample log: ```2024-06-12T15:18:22Z INFO runtime.tokenize: tokenizer loaded vocab size=50257 for revision=7.2.1``` Errors down from ~8% -> 0.6% over last 3 mins.

dave_custsuc: contacting AcmeAnalytics now with update: told them we've rolled back and are monitoring, ETA for full recovery ~10-15m. They acknowledged.

erin_product: any customers who saw data leakage or tokenization-corruption risk? We should include guidance.

carol_sre: from logs it looks like there were malformed outputs but no PII exfil detected. Recommend we run a small evaluation on affected request logs for safety and produce a short customer-facing summary.

alice_oncall: current status: mitigated (rollback). Monitoring in progress. Will keep channel open for 30m for handoff. Postmortem owner? Erin or Bob?

erin_product: I'll own postmortem coordination (writeup + customer note). Bob, can you collect the runtime logs and the catalog promotion job payload?

bob_runtime: will collect artifacts: runtime logs slice, catalog promotion event JSON, object storage list for tokenizer artifacts. Posting link when ready.

incident-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED -> rollback applied. PagerDuty alert PD-89234 auto-resolved by rollback job.

alice_oncall: grabbing a final metric screenshot and then handing to next oncall (carol) for overnight watch. Handing off at 15:30 UTC.

carol_sre: ack. I'll continue monitoring metrics and escalate if error rate creeps above 1% again. Please add runbook step to block promotions when artifact checksum missing.

erin_product: noted. I'll open a follow-up ticket to change promotion gating and add artifact checksum verification. Also drafting customer note for AcmeAnalytics and others potentially affected.

dave_custsuc: Acme replied: appreciated quick fix, wants timeline + why it happened. I'll loop legal if they request further SLA credits.

alice_oncall: summary for postmortem: root cause = promotion pipeline updated catalog metadata without ensuring tokenizer artifact available (race). Mitigation = catalog rollback. Next steps: - patch promotion pipeline to validate artifact availability and checksum - add pre-promotion dry-run checks - add alert for artifact-objectstore mismatch - update runbook to prefer fallback variant instead of partial artifact usage.

erin_product: assigning follow-ups: PROJ-1127 (promotion gating), PROJ-1128 (customer communication), PROJ-1129 (runbook update).

alice_oncall: closing active response. last observed error rate 0.5% and counting down. If no regression by 15:50 UTC we'll mark incident closed then send a short blameless postmortem. Thanks all. :bow:
